title: Bots coordinate with one another
description: Ryan 11-02: the newsroom editor bot coordinates with section desk bots and Story conversations. I found no bot-to-bot path in the domain code; confirm. Decide how one bot asks another for work and receives the result, with a limit on loops and on spend, and with the cost attributed. Consider whether this is the sub-agent tool (378eed) reaching another bot. Done: design, then Gherkin scenarios for a request and answer between bots, a refused loop, and cost attribution.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Correction: bot-to-bot messaging already exists (docs/MESSAGING.md 'Bot to bot'; features/message_admission.feature:17): a bot posts addressed to another bot on the same channel and a turn is enqueued. This task is narrower: reaching a bot in another channel, loop and spend limits, and cost attribution.
